;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[March 2020 Chad and Nigeria massacres]]
***[[Boko Haram]] [[jihadist]]s kill 92 soldiers at an [[Military of Chad|army]] base in [[Chad]]. [https://rte.ie/news/2020/0324/1126171-92-chadian-soldiers-killed-in-attack-by-boko-haram (RTÉ News and Current Affairs)]  
***[[Boko Haram]] kills 70 [[Nigerian Armed Forces|troops]] in an [[ambush]] in [[Borno State|Borno]], northeastern [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/nigeria-security-idUSL8N2BH6YL (Reuters)]
*[[Islamist insurgency in Mozambique]]
**[[Islamist]] militants seize the port town of [[Mocímboa da Praia]] in [[Cabo Delgado Province]], [[Mozambique]] after capturing the town's [[military base]] in an overnight attack. Residents say militants have blocked all exits in the town. The [[Mozambique Defence Armed Forces|armed forces]] and police launch a counter-offensive. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-52005899 (BBC News)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**The [[Syrian Air Defense Force]] says that it intercepted a [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drone]] near [[Khmeimim Air Base]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-attack/syrian-air-defense-intercepts-a-drone-in-the-vicinity-of-syrias-hmeimim-air-base-idUKKBN21A3VQ (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cinema]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
***About 500 cinemas reopen in [[China]]. [https://deadline.com/2020/03/china-movie-theaters-open-500-international-box-office-1202890025/ (''Deadline Hollywood'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
***[[Italians|Italian]] actress and former [[beauty pageant]] winner [[Lucia Bosè]] [[List of deaths due to the COVID-19 pandemic|dies]] aged 89 from [[pneumonia]] complicated by [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.billboard.com/articles/columns/latin/9340515/lucia-bose-dead-actress-dies (''Billboard'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]], [[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***[[Fast food restaurant]] chain [[McDonald's]] closes all of its restaurants in the [[United Kingdom]] and [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] citing the safety of its employees and customers amid the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/mar/22/mcdonalds-to-close-restaurants-in-uk-and-ireland-on-monday (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The [[United States Senate]] votes down for a second time a stimulus relief package. [https://fox4kc.com/tracking-coronavirus/watch-live-u-s-senate-votes-on-covid-19-stimulus-bill/ (WDAF-TV)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/23/coronavirus-updates-talks-on-senate-stimulus-bill-continue-vote-pushed-to-noon.html (CNBC)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/us-policy/2020/03/23/trump-coronavirus-senate-economic-stimulus/ (''The Washington Post'')]
***The [[Federal Reserve Bank]] announces the commitment to buy any amount of government-backed securities needed to keep interest rates down. Among other measures being developed to support the [[real economy]], it will also establish a special purpose vehicle allowing it to buy investment-grade [[corporate bond]]s directly. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-fed-rescue-analysi/with-latest-moves-fed-becomes-creditor-in-chief-for-u-s-business-idUSKBN21A3JX (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[Vanuatu]] puts the island of [[Aneityum]] under "temporary lockdown" after a [[cruise ship]] with a reportedly infected passenger on board visited the island. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/412385/vanuatu-island-under-lockdown-after-cruise-ship-visit (Radio New Zealand)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
****New Zealand enters [[New Zealand coronavirus alert level|alert level]] 3 after the investigation into two assumed community-spread cases do not find any links to travel. All schools and public venues are closed. The country will enter alert level 4 on 26 March at midnight local time. [https://i.stuff.co.nz/national/health/coronavirus/120495548/live-pm-jacinda-ardern-to-give-update-on-coronavirus-alert-level (Stuff)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji]]
****[[Fiji]] confirms its third case of COVID-19. [https://www.fbcnews.com.fj/news/fijis-third-covid-19-case-confirmed/ (FBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****Spain's [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Ministry of Health]] reports 4,000 new confirmed coronavirus cases, rising to 33,000 infected and 2,182 dead. [https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/live-blog/coronavirus-updates-stimulus-bill-fails-senate-canada-australia-pull-out-n1166286/ncrd1166396?fbclid=IwAR2kHhwBgBEyfSeVDnnbY43G8fw8K7K_SxWob483sOoeAA8Ba5J1eWxWWSc (NBC News)]
****The [[Spanish Army]] has found elderly people abandoned and dead inside retirement homes, according to Defence Minister [[Margarita Robles]]. A criminal investigation has been launched. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-52014023 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[British Army]] begins [[Operation Rescript]], to assist the [[United Kingdom|UK]]'s efforts to tackle the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/coronavirus-british-army-frontline-nhs-staff-personal-protective-equipment-a9417456.html (''The Independent'')]
****The [[United Kingdom]] is placed in lockdown. The new measures close all non-essential stores and ban gatherings of more than two people. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2020/mar/23/uk-coronavirus-live-news-latest-boris-johnson-minister-condemns-people-ignoring-two-metre-distance-rule-in-parks-as-very-selfish (''The Guardian'')]
****[[Downing Street]] says [[Foreign Secretary of the United Kingdom|Foreign Secretary]] [[Dominic Raab]] is the "designated survivor" to replace [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] if he became "incapacitated" due to COVID-19. The clarification comes after the issue was raised by MP [[Peter Bone]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/coronavirus-boris-johnson-dominic-raab-prime-minister-a9418246.html (''The Independent'')]
****The British government announces that [[ExCeL London]] will be turned into a 4000-bed hospital to open next week, staffed primarily by military medics. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/mar/23/nhs-plans-to-turn-excel-centre-into-coronavirus-hospital (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
****The [[Netherlands|Dutch]] [[Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport|Health Ministry]] reports 545 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 34 more deaths, bringing the total number of cases to 4,749 and 213 deaths. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-netherlands-tally/confirmed-coronavirus-infections-in-netherlands-rise-13-34-new-deaths-idUKKBN21A2C0 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malta]]
****[[Malta]]'s [[government of Malta|government]] announces that citizens who test positive for COVID-19 and disobey self-isolation rules will be fined 10,000 [[euro]]s. [https://timesofmalta.com/articles/view/covid-19-fines-may-be-increased-up-to-10000.780452 (''Times of Malta'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]]
****[[President of Cyprus|President]] [[Nicos Anastasiades]] announces the order of a nationwide lockdown between 24 March and 13 April. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-03-23/cyprus-to-impose-lockdown-to-contain-spread-of-coronavirus (Bloomberg)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan]] 
****The [[Government of Uzbekistan|government]] announces that a lockdown of [[Tashkent]] will begin on March 24. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/03/23/world/asia/23reuters-health-coronavirus-uzbekistan-lockdown.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Myanmar]]
****[[Myanmar]] reports the country's first confirmed cases of COVID-19, the patients are a 36-year-old who had travelled back from the [[United States]] and a 26-year-old returning from the United Kingdom. [[Panic buying]] is reported in the country's largest city, [[Yangon]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/myanmar-confirms-first-coronavirus-cases-12569458 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]]
****[[Dubai]] closes all restaurants, cafes and food locals for two weeks. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/gulf/2020/03/23/Coronavirus-Dubai-closes-all-restaurants-coffee-shops.html (Alarabiya in English)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]]
****[[President of Tunisia|President]] [[Kais Saied]] orders the [[Tunisian Army|army]] to deploy in the streets to enforce a lockdown in response to the coronavirus. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-tunisia-army-idUSKBN21A2EH (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
****[[President of South Africa|President]] [[Cyril Ramaphosa]] announces a 21-day nationwide lockdown effective from March 26, to contain the coronavirus, as the number of confirmed cases rises to 402. Soldiers will be deployed to help [[Law enforcement in South Africa|police]] enforce the lockdown. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-safrica/south-africa-to-impose-21-day-lockdown-as-coronavirus-cases-jump-idUKKBN21A3C6 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sudan]]
****[[Sudan]]'s [[South Darfur]] [[States of Sudan|state]] reports eight new cases of [[COVID-19]], including two [[Egyptian Armed Forces|Egyptian soldiers]] of the [[United Nations–African Union Mission in Darfur]] (UNAMID). [https://sudantribune.com/article/67244 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Canada]]
*****[[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] announces that [[Canada]] will spend $192M to develop a [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://globalnews.ca/video/6718304/coronavirus-outbreak-trudeau-announces-canada-to-spend-192m-on-developing-covid-19-vaccine/ (Global News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Toronto]]
******[[Mayor of Toronto]] [[John Tory]] declares a state of emergency for the city of [[Toronto]]. [https://toronto.ctvnews.ca/toronto-declares-state-of-emergency-amid-covid-19-pandemic-1.4864679 (CFTO-DT)]
*****[[Ontario Premier|Premier]] [[Doug Ford]] announces that non-essential businesses in [[Ontario]] are to be shut down for at least two weeks. [https://nationalpost.com/news/covid-19-ontario-and-quebec-order-non-essential-businesses-closed-after-spike-in-coronavirus-totals (''National Post'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]]
*****[[Quebec Premier|Premier]] [[François Legault]] announces that non-essential businesses in [[Quebec]] are to be shut down for three weeks. [https://nationalpost.com/news/covid-19-ontario-and-quebec-order-non-essential-businesses-closed-after-spike-in-coronavirus-totals (''National Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hawaii]]
*****''[[Norwegian Jewel]]'' arrives at [[Honolulu]] after cutting its trip short due to COVID-19 and mechanical problems. No positive cases were confirmed among the passengers and crew members. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/troubled-cruise-ship-2000-passengers-docks-honolulu-69741376 (ABC News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Massachusetts]]
*****[[Governor of Massachusetts|Governor]] [[Charlie Baker]] orders all businesses and organizations not providing essential services to close until April 7, effective at noon on Tuesday. Baker states that he is not issuing a stay-at-home order, saying it "doesn't make sense from a public health point of view", but has directed the [[Massachusetts Department of Public Health]] to issue a stay-at-home advisory, limiting public gatherings to 10 people or less. [https://www.wbur.org/commonhealth/2020/03/23/baker-closes-businesses-coronavirus (WBUR-FM)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[Michigan]] [[Governor of Michigan|Governor]] [[Gretchen Whitmer]] issues a stay-at-home order for all Michiganders except for essential services. [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/michigan-becomes-latest-state-to-issue-stay-at-home-to-curb-coronavirus-spread (Fox News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
*****[[New York (state)|New York]] is expected to be the first state to test the treatment of coronavirus with blood from recovered patients. [https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-care/new-york-will-be-first-state-test-treatment-coronavirus-blood-n1167136 (NBC News)]

**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ghana]]
***Eight people are arrested at a market in [[Ashaiman]] for violating restrictions while disinfection on the market began. [https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/NewsArchive/Coronavirus-Mass-disinfection-exercise-conducted-in-Accra-markets-902116 (''GhanaWeb'')]
*[[Capital punishment in the United States]], [[Capital punishment in Colorado]]
**[[Colorado]] abolishes the death penalty and commutes sentences of death row inmates. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/23/us/colorado-death-penalty-repeal.html (''The New York Times'')]
*The [[Pacific Gas and Electric Company]] is expected to plead guilty to 84 counts of manslaughter in the [[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]] in [[2018 California wildfires|2018]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/pg-e-plead-guilty-manslaughter-california-camp-fire-n1166471 (NBC News)]
